symptom: MDL could not write the two values lint gained readers for in #1269: `/** Sales data */ create or modify module MyFirstModule;` warned "the doc comment before `create or modify module MyFirstModule` is lost … that statement cannot store documentation, so the comment is ignored [MDL089]", and `alter app security (AdminUserName: 'appadmin');` failed "alter app security has no property \"AdminUserName\"". Every MDL-built module had empty documentation and the admin was always MxAdmin, so the lint rules over them had no negative case. Issue mendixlabs/mxcli#1314
cause: Read-only by design at the time: #1269 added DomainModel.Documentation to the semantic model as read-only, and no backend method wrote it or Security$ProjectSecurity.AdminUserName (gen's SetDocumentation/SetAdminUserName were never called). CreateModuleStmt had no Documentation field, so storesDocumentation() reported its doc comment as detached.
file: mdl/visitor/visitor_module.go, mdl/visitor/visitor_security.go (appSecurityKeys), mdl/executor/cmd_modules.go (execCreateModule, setModuleDocumentation, describeModule), mdl/executor/cmd_security_write.go, mdl/backend/modelsdk/domainmodel_alter.go (SetDomainModelDocumentation), mdl/backend/modelsdk/security_write.go (SetProjectAdminUserName)
fix: The doc comment on `create [or modify] module` is the domain model's documentation (a Projects$Module has none): new module -> set; existing + `or modify` -> set (`/** */` clears, no comment preserves); plain create of an existing module stays a no-op and says documentation is unchanged. describe module prints it as that comment. `AdminUserName: '<name>'` joins alter app security's property list (string only, non-empty; password stays out per #624).
insight: **MDL089 is a capability map, not just a warning**: storesDocumentation() decides by reflecting on the AST for a Documentation field, so adding the field silences MDL089 by itself — the visitor test must assert the field is filled, not only that no detached comment is reported, or a half-wired change passes. When the obvious owner has no property (Projects$Module), look one unit down: the module's documentation is DomainModels$DomainModel.Documentation, which is what lint and Studio Pro's canvas pane show. Verified on a fresh 11.12.5 app: exec, describe round-trip, `select … from catalog.modules`, and `mx check` 0 errors against an untouched control. Repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/1314-module-documentation-and-admin-user-name.mdl`.
